description: This file contains a shell script that performs tests for the 'git fast-export' and 'git fast-import' commands, specifically testing the '--anonymize' option and related features. It defines setup procedures, runs various assertions on the exported stream to verify correct anonymization, and tests the import process into a new repository, checking repository structure, branches, commits, and tags.
